Format: 4:5 vertical or landscape
Reference assets to attach: assets/desktop-ui/alpa-dashboard-desktop-main.png, assets/logos/alpa-logo-main.png
Asset usage instructions: Naturally composite the ALPA dashboard screenshot into the laptop display, preserve real UI proportions, integrate the ALPA logo subtly on a corner or on a desk accessory.
Realism rules: Muted palette, real textures, controlled natural light, editorial photographic quality, sharp and composed with negative space.
Avoid: Bright colors, flashy typography, fake overlays, multiple screens or cluttered props.

visual_prompt_versions.text: Scene: A peaceful Sunday morning in a city park with soft natural light filtering through trees onto a small wooden picnic table. On the table rests a neatly organized notebook with a pen, a smartphone showing a subtle ALPA logo on its screen lock, and a steaming cup of coffee. Nearby, a relaxed freelancer leans back on the bench, eyes closed briefly, shoulders relaxed, enjoying a moment of calm post-workflow. The laptop is closed or absent, emphasizing freedom from spreadsheets. The scene suggests quiet momentum and accomplishment through leisure and clarity, indirect ALPA presence conveyed by the branded phone lock screen and minimalist notebook. Format: 4:5 vertical or landscape Reference assets to attach: assets/logos/alpa-logo-main.png Asset usage instructions: Integrate the ALPA logo subtly as a soft reflection or embossed detail on the smartphone screen, keeping it low-key and believable, no intrusive branding. Realism rules: Natural outdoor lighting, documentary style, warm and soft focus with shallow depth of field, believable human posture and environment, no forced poses or over-staged setup. Avoid: No computer or dashboard screens visible, no messy or cluttered desk props, no busy backgrounds, no overt promotional elements, no bright colors or stylized typography.

visual_prompt_versions.text: Scene: A modern, minimalist desk with a single analog clock showing an early finish time (e.g., 3 PM). On the desk: a cold, half-full coffee mug beside a small stack of neatly organized, printed lead sheets titled "Verified Contacts" with clean typography. Next to them lies a closed laptop with a subtle ALPA logo engraved or embossed on the lid. In the background, a plain wall with soft shadows and a faint, out-of-focus calendar marking the weekend as completed early. The composition contrasts the past manual research clutter replaced by streamlined outputs and early completion—emphasizing time saved and calm reclaimed. The atmosphere conveys relief and quiet confidence, using cool muted tones and natural window light filtering in gently from one side, creating soft shadows and texture. Format: 4:5 vertical Reference assets to attach: assets/logos/alpa-logo-main.png Asset usage instructions: Integrate the ALPA logo subtly as an embossed or engraved detail on the closed laptop lid, maintaining a discreet, premium brand presence without overt branding. Realism rules: Editorial quality with controlled natural lighting, shallow depth of field focusing on the lead sheets and clock, believable workspace textures, and human-scale details without people. Avoid: No computer or dashboard screens visible, no busy or cluttered desks, no bright colors or stylized typography on scene elements, no forced human poses, no over-styled product placement or promotional text.

visual_prompt_versions.text: Scene: A focused moment at a tidy workspace where a person’s hands swiftly scroll through a well-organized smartphone contact list showing clear, named entries ready to call or message. Nearby, a sleek closed notebook labeled subtly with the ALPA logo rests beside the phone. The environment suggests immediacy and readiness—an upcoming meeting visible on a lightweight paper planner or calendar marked with a prompt countdown. The workspace is neat, with just a single pen and the smartphone on a smooth wooden surface; natural light from a side window casts calm but alert shadows. The image captures the decisive final step before outreach, conveying speed and confidence in getting real leads fast. Format: 4:5 vertical Reference assets to attach: assets/logos/alpa-logo-main.png Asset usage instructions: Integrate the ALPA logo on the notebook cover discreetly, with subtle embossing for brand presence without distraction. Realism rules: Editorial quality with authentic human detail (hands in natural position), soft, natural window light, shallow depth of field focusing on the phone screen and notebook, realistic textures of wood and paper, no posed figures or stylized elements. Avoid: No visible computer screens or dashboards, no cluttered desks, no overt branding or UI overlays, no busy backgrounds, no forced human poses or exaggerated expressions, no bright or artificial colors.
